reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named independent lab with a report for each batch is exactly what I check before buying. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one box and read the report before the first sachet.
objection: It's one form, bisglycinate only, when other brands put several forms in one capsule. It's also a new brand with no reviews yet, so the lab report has to hold up when I actually open it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be missing, vague, or didn't show the actual magnesium amount per batch, I'd pass. A few real reviews from verified buyers would make me more comfortable.
